summary_brief: 今日 (2026-01-26) 发现 8 个 Commit 信号，9 个 Release 信号。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 执行状态追踪
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 修复 Agent 执行完成时的元数据设置，确保系统能准确追踪和响应异步任务的生命周期。

engineering_signals.title: Ollama 认证漏洞修复
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 修复 Ollama 集成中的关键认证漏洞，防止本地 LLM 服务被未授权访问或劫持。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 数量限制与控制
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 引入子 Agent 数量上限机制，防止多智能体系统因无限递归创建子任务而导致资源耗尽。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 工具与 IPFS 集成
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 引入基于 MCP (Model Context Protocol) 的插件系统，并支持 IPFS 注册表，增强了 Agent 工具的互操作性和去中心化能力。

engineering_signals.title: 多账户令牌刷新机制
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 实现了多配置文件账户切换时的自动令牌刷新和队列路由，提升了长时间运行任务的稳定性。

engineering_signals.title: Gemini 浮点响应处理
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 增强了 Gemini LLM 工具对浮点数响应的处理能力，解决了特定数据类型解析失败的问题。

engineering_signals.title: Zeta2/Mercury 语法优化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 对 Zeta2 和 Mercury 语法应用了前后缀剥离优化，提升了代码解析和显示的性能。

engineering_signals.title: 终端进程冻结修复
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了子进程被信号杀死时终端冻结的 Bug，显著提升了编辑器在执行构建任务时的稳定性。

releases.summary:
## Changes

### PR [#1969](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/1969) by [ksylvan](https://github.com/ksylvan): Critical and High Impact NPM dependabot issues fixed

- Security: fix critical and high priority npm vulnerabilities including form-data upgrade to 4.0.5, glob upgrade to ≥10.5.0, and qs upgrade to 6.14.1
- Security: fix critical ollama authentication vulnerability by updating from v0.13.5 to v0.15.1 to prevent unauthorized model management operations
- Security: add npm support with package-lock.json for dual package manager compatibility, enabling both npm and pnpm users to maintain consistent security posture

### Direct commits

- Chore: remove deprecated wisdom extraction patterns from pattern libraries

- Remove extract_wisdom_short from pattern descriptions catalog
- Drop extract_wisdomjm pattern extract definition

- Delete extract_wisdom_short extract template block

key_changes: 修复关键和高危 NPM 安全漏洞，包括 form-data、glob 和 qs 依赖项升级
修复 ollama 认证漏洞（从 v0.13.5 升级到 v0.15.1），防止未授权模型管理操作
添加 package-lock.json 支持，实现 npm 和 pnpm 双包管理器兼容
移除已废弃的 wisdom 提取模式（extract_wisdom_short 等）
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次版本主要修复了多项关键和高危安全漏洞，包括 NPM 依赖项（form-data、glob、qs）的升级以及 ollama 认证漏洞的修复（从 v0.13.5 升级到 v0.15.1）。同时添加了 package-lock.json 以支持 npm 和 pnpm 双包管理器兼容，并移除了已废弃的 wisdom 提取模式。

## Changes

### PR [#1968](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/1968) by [ksylvan](https://github.com/ksylvan): New `extract_all_quotes` and move misplaced patterns

- Move orphaned pattern files from patterns/ to data/patterns/
- Add extract_all_quotes pattern for quote extraction
- The extract_all_quotes is originally from [PR #176](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/176) by [@CPAtoCybersecurity](https://github.com/CPAtoCybersecurity)
- The `suggest_pattern` pattern is updated with the following additions.
  - extract_bd_ideas for actionable idea extraction
  - suggest_gt_command for GT command suggestions
  - create_bd_issue for issue tracking commands

key_changes: 新增 extract_all_quotes 模式用于提取引用内容
整理项目结构，将孤立的模式文件从 patterns/ 移至 data/patterns/
增强 suggest_pattern 模式，新增三个子功能：extract_bd_ideas（提取可执行想法）、suggest_gt_command（GT 命令建议）、create_bd_issue（创建问题追踪命令）
ai_summary.summary_cn: Fabric v1.4.392 主要引入了新的引用提取功能 extract_all_quotes，并整理了项目文件结构。同时增强了 suggest_pattern 模式，新增了三个实用的子功能以支持想法提取、命令建议和问题追踪。

releases.summary:
## New Features
- Added a network sandbox proxy with policy enforcement to better control outbound network access. (#8442)
- Introduced the first phase of connectors support via the app server and MCP integration, including new config/docs updates. (#9667)
- Shipped collaboration mode as beta in the TUI, with a clearer plan → execute handoff and simplified mode selection (Coding vs Plan). (#9690, #9712, #9802, #9834)
- Added ephemeral threads and improved collaboration tool provenance metadata for spawned threads. (#9765, #9769)
- WebSocket connections now support proxy configuration. (#9719)
- More strict limitation on multi-agents

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed exec policy parsing for multiline quoted arguments. (#9565)
- `--yolo` now skips the git repository check instead of failing outside a repo. (#9590)
- Improved resume reliability by handling out-of-order events and prompting for the working directory when it differs. (#9512, #9731)
- Backspace no longer deletes a text element when the cursor is at the element’s left edge. (#9630)
- Config loading errors are clearer and more actionable across surfaces. (#9746)
- Default model selection now respects filtered presets to avoid invalid defaults. (#9782)

## Documentation
- Corrected a typo in the experimental collaboration prompt template. (#9716)
- Added documentation for the new connectors configuration surface. (#9667)

- Updated GitHub Actions for Node 24 compatibility. (#9722)
